#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long inverseMod(long long x) {
    long long exp = MOD - 2;
    long long res = 1;
    long long base = x;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

struct Node {
    int c50, c100, b, n;
    long long am;
    vector<Node*> s;
    Node(int c50_, int c100_, int b_) : c50(c50_), c100(c100_), b(b_), n(0), am(0) {}
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    vector<long long> fact(51, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < 51; i++) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
    }

    long long combs[51][51];
    for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++) {
        combs[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            combs[i][j] = (fact[i] * inverseMod((fact[j] * fact[i - j]) % MOD)) % MOD;
        }
    }

    int totalCards, maxCards;
    cin >> totalCards >> maxCards;
    int c50Count = 0, c100Count = 0;
    vector<int> vals(totalCards);
    for (int i = 0; i < totalCards; i++) {
        cin >> vals[i];
        if (vals[i] == 100) c100Count++;
        else c50Count++;
    }

    vector<vector<vector<Node*>>> graphNodes(c50Count + 1, vector<vector<Node*>>(c100Count + 1, vector<Node*>(2)));
    for (int i = 0; i <= c50Count; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= c100Count; j++) {
            graphNodes[i][j][0] = new Node(i, j, 0);
            graphNodes[i][j][1] = new Node(i, j, 1);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i <= c50Count; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= c100Count; j++) {
            int max50Pick = min(maxCards / 50, i);
            int max100Pick = min(maxCards / 100, j);
            for (int x = max100Pick; x >= 0; x--) {
                for (int y = min(max50Pick, (maxCards - 100 * x) / 50); y >= 0; y--) {
                    if (x == 0 && y == 0) continue;
                    graphNodes[i][j][0]->s.push_back(graphNodes[i - y][j - x][1]);
                    graphNodes[i - y][j - x][1]->s.push_back(graphNodes[i][j][0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    queue<Node*> q;
    graphNodes[c50Count][c100Count][0]->n = 1;
    graphNodes[c50Count][c100Count][0]->am = 1;
    q.push(graphNodes[c50Count][c100Count][0]);

    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node* current = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (auto neighbor : current->s) {
            if (neighbor->n == 0 || neighbor->n == current->n + 1) {
                long long p1 = combs[current->b == 0 ? current->c50 : c50Count - current->c50][abs(current->c50 - neighbor->c50)];
                long long p2 = combs[current->b == 0 ? current->c100 : c100Count - current->c100][abs(current->c100 - neighbor->c100)];
                neighbor->am = (neighbor->am + (current->am * (p1 * p2) % MOD)) % MOD;
                if (neighbor->n == 0) {
                    neighbor->n = current->n + 1;
                    q.push(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << (graphNodes[0][0][1]->n - 1) << "\n" << graphNodes[0][0][1]->am << "\n";

    // Cleanup allocated nodes
    for (int i = 0; i <= c50Count; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= c100Count; j++) {
            delete graphNodes[i][j][0];
            delete graphNodes[i][j][1];
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
